Sub-admin test creates/deletes its own doc (email test_iter409@sksharma.test). Masters test creates and deletes its own group + holiday. Compliance policy is restored to original at the end. Bonus run row remains (harmless statistical snapshot for FY 2025-26).

minor.issue: Backend silently lower-cases the email on create — documented behaviour (matches uniqueness index) but frontend should either lower-case before submit or reflect the stored value back to the user.

Legacy Actual salary-run reprocess still requires body.month (Pydantic model). Iter 408 flagged the same gap on compliance-salary-runs which was fixed in 409. Consider making month optional here too and deriving from the stored run.
Response envelope key is 'runs' (not 'items' like the bonus/masters endpoints). Not a bug — just inconsistent shape. Frontend tests must know the difference.
